decode.value: weight[o, i] * scale_inv[o / bo, i / bi]

doc: float8_e4m3fn weights with a float scale per (bo × bi) block (DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3-FP8: `weight` + `weight_scale_inv`): W = fp8(w) · scale_inv. The elements are floats, not integer codes under a group scale, so it decodes to floats and the weight takes the ordinary W8 path.

checks.expr: dim_scale_inv[0] == (out + bo - 1) / bo && dim_scale_inv[1] == (inp + bi - 1) / bi
checks.message: the block scales are not [ceil(out / bo), ceil(in / bi)]

name: FP8_BLOCK
